icon.description: Optional icon image for the tile.

facets.description: Rich text facets for the description (links, mentions, hashtags).

params.description: Input parameters this tile accepts. When present, the tile runtime shows a configuration form for required parameters without defaults before loading the tile.

content.description: The tile content, either a single resource or a bundle.

aspectRatio.description: Declared aspect ratio for tile rendering.

description.description: Optional rich text description of the tile.

interactions.description: Declaration of the XRPC methods, collections, and services this tile interacts with.

loadingImage.description: Optional loading screen image for the tile.

main.description: A tile with a name and associated resource or bundle.

name.description: Parameter name, used as a URL search param key. Must not start with an underscore.

default.description: Default value for this parameter, encoded as a string.

required.description: Whether this parameter must be provided before loading the tile.

param.description: Declares an input parameter for a tile, similar to XRPC query parameters.

methods.description: XRPC method NSIDs this tile may call. When present, the tile runtime restricts XRPC calls to only these methods. When absent, all server-allowed methods may be called (with user consent).

services.description: AT Protocol service proxy targets this tile interacts with, identified by DID and service endpoint fragment.

collections.description: Repository collection NSIDs this tile reads from or writes to.

interactions.description: Declares the AT Protocol interactions a tile performs. Methods listed here gate which XRPC calls the tile is allowed to attempt (the user must still grant per-method consent). Collections and services are informational metadata for display and auditing.

schema.description: A Web Tile record for DASL.
